{{short description|French researcher and chemist (born 1945)}}
'''Daniel Mansuy''' is a French researcher and [[chemist]] born in 1945 in [[Châteauroux]] (Indre), a member of the [[French Academy of Sciences]].<ref name="Institut de France - French Academy of Sciences - Daniel Mansuy">{{cite web |title=Daniel Mansuy |url=https://www.academie-sciences.fr/fr/Liste-des-membres-de-l-Academie-des-sciences-/-M/daniel-mansuy.html |website=[[Institut de France]] |publisher=[[French Academy of Sciences]] |accessdate=9 August 2019}}</ref>

== Biography ==
Daniel Mansuy graduated from the [[Chimie ParisTech|École nationale supérieure de chimie de Paris]] (now Chimie Paris Tech) in 1967 and obtained a [[doctorate]] in science from the [[Pierre and Marie Curie University|Université Pierre-et-Marie-Curie]] in 1970 under the supervision of [[Marc Julia]].<ref name="LCBPT">[http://www.biomedicale.univ-paris5.fr/umr8601/MANSUY-Daniel.html Page de Daniel Mansuy sur le site du ''Laboratoire de Chimie & Biochimie Pharmacologiques et Toxicologiques'']</ref> He then joined the [[Centre national de la recherche scientifique|CNRS]] as a research manager and then director of research in 1992. He was co-founder in 1984 and director (1984-1996 and 1999-2005) of the Laboratory of  Pharmaceutical and Toxicological Chemistry and Biochemistry at [[Paris Descartes University]].<ref>[http://www.biomedicale.univ-paris5.fr/umr8601/ Site du ''Laboratoire de Chimie & Biochimie Pharmacologiques et Toxicologiques'']</ref> He is currently Director of Research Emeritus Outstanding Class.

== Scientific work ==
[[File:FeTPP(CCl2)Mansuy.png|thumb|Structure of Fe(TPP)C<sub>2</sub>(C<sub>6</sub>H<sub>4</sub>Cl)<sub>2</sub>, one of several iron carbenoid complexes prepared by Mansuy (TPP = conjugate base of [[tetraphenylporphyrin]]).<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1021/ic00279a023|title=Nature of the complexes derived from the reaction of 1,1-bis(p-chlorophenyl)-2,2,2-trichloroethane (DDT) with iron porphyrins: Crystal and molecular structure of the vinylidene carbene complex Fe(TPP)(C:C(p-ClC6H4)2)|journal=Inorganic Chemistry|volume=27|issue=6|pages=1052–1056|year=1988|last1=Mansuy|first1=Daniel|last2=Battioni|first2=Jean Paul|last3=Lavallee|first3=David K.|last4=Fischer|first4=Jean|last5=Weiss|first5=Raymond}}</ref>]]
Daniel Mansuy is particularly interested in phenomena at the interface between [[chemistry]] and [[biology]], and in particular in the chemistry and pharmacochemistry of [[Cytochrome P450|cytochromes P450]]. His work has led to the discovery of a new class of carbene and [[Nitrenium ion|nitrene]] [[iron]] complexes<ref>{{cite journal|doi=10.1002/anie.197807811|title=Dichlorocarbene Complexes of Iron(II)-Porphyrins–Crystal and Molecular Structure of Fe(TPP)(CCl2)(H2O)|journal=Angewandte Chemie International Edition in English|volume=17|issue=10|pages=781–782|year=1978|last1=Mansuy|first1=Daniel|last2=Lange|first2=Marc|last3=Chottard|first3=J. C.|last4=Bartoli|first4=J. F.|last5=Chevrier|first5=Bernard|last6=Weiss|first6=Raymond}}</ref>  and of one of the first catalytic systems of nitrene transfer to alkanes and alkenes.  He has also developed new [[Catalysis|catalysts]] for the oxidation of [[alkane]]s, [[alkene]]s and [[aromatics]], used to predict drug [[metabolism]] and in the field of [[pollution]] control.  In the field of molecular toxicology, his work has led to understand the molecular origin of drug interactions involving [[macrolide]] [[antibiotic]]s such as TAO and of immunoallergic drug [[hepatitis]] due to tienilic acid.

He is the author or co-author of more than 400 scientific publications.<ref>{{cite web|title=Google Scholar|url=https://scholar.google.com/scholar?hl=fr&as_sdt=0%2C5&q=Daniel+Mansuy&btnG=|date=}}</ref>

* Elected member of the French Academy of Sciences (1998)<ref name="academie" />
*Ehrlich Award of the French Society of Therapeutic Chemistry (1999)
* Elected Associate Member of the French National Academy of Pharmacy (2010)<ref>{{cite web|title=Académie nationale de Pharmacie|url=https://www.acadpharm.org/qui_sommes_nous/aff_membre.php?memb_id=1154&fil_post=&fil_nom=&fil_sect=&que_act=O&fil_pays=&fil_bureau=&fil_conseil=&page=18&ipp=20|date=}}</ref>
